milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the purple bed (inside the oak planks building) and face toward it to demonstrate they have found it. Target is the center of the purple bed at spawn-relative (8, 2, 8). max_distance=16 allows detection from within or near the building, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the bed.
